title: Mark a PDF CONFIDENTIAL: A Watermark Is Not Redaction
description: Add a visible CONFIDENTIAL watermark to label a PDF copy, while keeping required content readable.
direct: Use CONFIDENTIAL to label a PDF copy. If the recipient must not see certain information, use a tool that removes it and verify the resulting file before sharing.

cards.choice.heading: Label versus remove
cards.choice.body: A watermark communicates handling intent. Redaction removes selected content from the deliverable. A pale stamp, black-looking overlay or flattened preview should not be treated as proof that the underlying text and metadata are gone.
sections.explain.heading: What the watermark does not prove
sections.explain.body: A visible mark is not encryption, an access permission, a digital signature or a reliable barrier against copying. It also cannot establish who is authorized to receive the document. Avoid putting a sensitive account number into the watermark itself: the mark becomes another visible copy of that information.
sections.practice.heading: Know the tool boundary
sections.practice.body: Its current public features are text watermarks, opacity, size, color and page previews, with exports requiring Pro. Redaction is not claimed. Watermarking runs on device and creates a separate PDF, but local processing alone does not make sharing the finished document safe for every recipient.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: Is it safe to put an account number in the watermark itself?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Only if you are authorized to share that number with everyone who will receive the file. A generic status or purpose is usually enough for a handling label.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Should I send a copy if I can still search for text I meant to remove?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: No. Treat that copy as unredacted. Return to the authorized redaction workflow and verify the exact PDF you will send.

steps.step-1.text: Decide whether the recipient needs a labeled complete document or a copy with information removed. Confirm their requirements first.
steps.step-2.text: For labeling only, open the PDF in PDF Watermark & Stamp, enter CONFIDENTIAL or an appropriate purpose, and preview the pages.
steps.step-3.text: Export the new marked copy and inspect it outside the app. Keep the original separate and verify that the label has not covered required content.
